name: Togo
summary_text: Togo is dangerous for trans visitors. The Penal Code criminalises “immodest or unnatural acts” (3 years); limited recent enforcement evidence but documented discrimination and violence; no LGR.

sources.claim_summary: NOTE: Not retrievable at research time (HTTP 403); the underlying Human Dignity Trust country profile documents Togo's criminalisation of same-sex activity (up to 3 years' imprisonment under the penal code).

Afrique Arc-En-Ciel Togo + Synergía alternative report (June 2021) to the UN Human Rights Committee's 132nd session: AAEC (founded 2007) fights HIV in MSM-TG populations and documents human-rights violations across Togo and francophone West Africa; legal and judicial support for victims, advocacy, capacity building.

sources.title: Togo - United States Department of State
sources.claim_summary: US State Department 2023 Human Rights Report for Togo: official assessment - same-sex conduct criminalised (Article 88); societal discrimination; no legal protections.

sources.title: Voices from LGBT Catholics in Western Africa
sources.claim_summary: Washington Blade (Aug 2015): 'Voices from LGBT Catholics in Western Africa' - the experiences of LGBT Catholics in the region including Togo.

US State Department 2011 Human Rights Report for Togo: documents security-force torture, impunity, and 'official and societal discrimination... against members of the lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender (LGBT) community'.

US State Department 2022 Human Rights Report for Togo: significant issues include cruel treatment, harsh prisons, arbitrary detention, criminal libel enforcement, and 'crimes involving violence or threats of violence targeting lesbian, gay, bisexual...' persons.
